public_payload.normalized_proposition: As of August 2023, generative AI has made perhaps hundreds of millions of dollars, probably not billions, and certainly not hundreds of billions.

statement.excerpt: And so far Generative AI hasn’t. Maybe hundreds of millions, probably not billions. certainly not hundreds of billions.
statement.document_title: What exactly are the economics of AI?

our_interpretation: Only the firm rejection of hundreds of billions is eligible for scoring. Billion-scale revenue would not contradict the qualified phrase 'probably not billions'.
The ordinary revenue reading is money earned from generative AI products and services. The surrounding discussion also mentions profits, so this reading is not explicit.
'So far' means cumulative earnings through August 14, 2023. No starting date or reporting quarter is supplied.
Treat hundreds of billions as the $100-billion order of magnitude. Evidence near the boundary would require clarification.
Marcus supplies no accounting basis for the sector-wide amount. Reports about OpenAI elsewhere in the passage do not establish a basis for the entire sector.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable evidence establishes that cumulative generative AI revenue through August 14, 2023 remained below the hundreds-of-billions band, with sufficiently complete coverage to bound the total.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable evidence establishes cumulative generative AI revenue clearly within or above the hundreds-of-billions band by August 14, 2023. Merely reaching billions does not contradict the scored commitment.
